title: Set Membership Estimation for Stochastic Linear Contextual Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2606.20022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contextual bandit learning has attracted increasing attention in engineering applications due to its ability to incorporate side/context information in time-varying environments. A widely used approach for contextual bandits is optimism in the face of uncertainty (OFU), in which uncertainty sets for unknown parameters are constructed and decisions are made optimistically over these sets. In the bandit literature, uncertainty sets are typically derived using statistical learning tools, such as confidence intervals. In contrast, set membership estimation (SME), a well-established uncertainty quantification approach in control and system identification, has received little attention in the bandit literature. translated_title: 随机线性上下文赌博机的集合成员估计
translated_abstract: 上下文赌博机学习由于能够在时变环境中融合辅助/上下文信息，在工程应用中受到越来越多的关注。上下文赌博机中一种广泛使用的方法是不确定性下的乐观主义（OFU），该方法为未知参数构建不确定性集合，并在这些集合上进行乐观决策。在赌博机文献中，不确定性集合通常借助统计学习工具（如置信区间）来推导。相比之下，集合成员估计（SME）——一种在控制与系统辨识领域已经成熟的量化不确定性的方法——在赌博机文献中却很少受到关注。本文以线性上下文赌博机为切入点，研究SME与上下文赌博机之间的联系。我们提出了一种基于SME的OFU算法，并在适当的条件下建立了次线性遗憾界。
tldr: 本文首次将控制与系统辨识领域成熟的集合成员估计（SME）方法引入线性上下文赌博机，提出基于SME的OFU算法并建立了次线性遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces set membership estimation (SME), a well-established uncertainty quantification approach from control and system identification, into linear contextual bandits, proposing an SME-based OFU algorithm with a sublinear regret bound.
